itemUsage.en: Uika Misumi, famous idol, guitarist and vocalist of Ave Mujica.
itemUsage.zh: Ave Mujica主唱兼吉他手三角初华，当红的人气明星。

itemDesc.en: Beneath her mild exterior lies a strong will to protect those who are dear to her.
itemDesc.zh: 温柔的外表下，是她努力想要守护重要之人的真心。

description.en:
Operator Uika Misumi has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for tactical support and low-level therapy of operators within proximity in coordination with fellow members of Ave Mujica.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Supporter Operator during field operations to exercise Bard responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.
description.zh:
干员三角初华擅长与Ave Mujica的成员协作配合，支援并缓慢治疗附近干员
根据外勤部门决议
在外勤任务中划分为辅助干员，行使吟游者职责
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明

description.en: It was while wandering around Rhodes Island absentmindedly that Uika met Astesia. Uika has been enchanted by the elegant yet mystifying astrology of Terra at first sight, and is happy to find a passionate kindred spirit in Astesia. The two become friends instantly. In making Astesia's divination room a regular destination, Uika begins to learn divination herself. Terra's sky is altogether not the sky Uika knew, and its every unknown is a fierce draw to her. Keeping an observation log of the stars as Astesia does, perusing the material Astesia gathers, sometimes having Astesia tell her fortune, she finds herself partaking in all sorts of particular little rituals while gazing the stellar sea. What fascinates Uika about divination isn't the results as much as the very method itself, and she picks up some sword skills involved in the divination ritual too. Feeling the stars' aspects as Astesia can is out of her reach, but Uika enjoys her time with astrology all the same. The days pass, and the two grow closer than ever. One day, they make time for tea brewed by Astesia, as they are sitting beside a miniature revolving planetarium. 'You really do love the stars, don't you, Uika? There aren't many at Rhodes Island who could say much about them. Terra's night sky and its astrology are both plagued with mystery, so it's rare anyone devotes their time and attention just out of love. Why do you look at the stars, I wonder?' Uika lapses into thought, then smiles and answers. 'Looking at the stars calms me down... they give me courage to deal with the pressure and negative emotions in life. That's why they're so special to me.' 'Really? So you're not, say, entrusting them with your feelings toward someone special?' 'Eh? Wh-What makes you think that?!' Uika has never flustered in front of Astesia until now. 'Well, whenever I see you looking up at the starry sky without a word, or learning how to divine... I see that look in your eyes—you hope to share that moment with a treasured one, and you pray for their happiness.' 'W-Was it really that easy to tell...?' Flustered, Uika's cheeks reddened. 'There's nothing embarrassing about it! I'm just like you. So I know just how you feel.' 'You do...?' 'I do. I have my dear little sister here at Rhodes Island too, and I have to keep going for her sake. Oh, but she does keep telling me how stubborn I am... Heheh. I have a ways to go as a big sister myself.' Oh. She sounds just like... I see. Maybe that's why we clicked so well. 'I know stargazing is a personal hobby of yours, but you're just as interested in divination, aren't you? Say, are you hoping to divine someone's fortune?' 'Oh, Astesia-san, you really...' Uika means to underline her gratitude with that, but Astesia suddenly leans in closer, brimming with intrigue. 'Is it family? Or a friend? Are they at Rhodes Island? Or back in your home country?' 'Er, well... it's—a little complicated, to be honest...'
description.zh:
因为一次无心的闲逛，初华在罗德岛上认识了星极。
只是一眼，初华就对优雅而神秘的泰拉占星术产生了极大的兴趣。星极也因为这样一位如此热情的同好的出现感到开心。两人一拍即合，初华便开始经常前往星极的占卜室学习。
泰拉的天空和初华所知的天空完全不同，有太多的未知吸引着她。她学着星极的样子去观察和记录，翻看星极已经整理好的资料。她也会让星极为她进行占卜，看着环绕的星点，参与特别的仪式，比起占卜的结果，初华更喜欢这样的过程。寻求占卜之余，初华还会向星极学习占卜手法和占星的剑仪。即使不管怎么尝试，初华都无法像星极那般感悟星象，但是并不妨碍她乐在其中。
经过一段时间后，两人也变得熟稔了起来。
一天，两人在闲暇之余，坐在旋转的星空灯旁，喝着星极泡好的淡茶。
“初华小姐真的很喜欢星星呢。罗德岛上很少有人能跟我聊这么多。泰拉的星空和占星学谜团众多，大家都不太想为此花费时间和精力。对初华小姐来说，观星的意义是什么？”
初华笑着想了想，说道：“对我来说，观察星空是能平复心情的意义非凡的事。它总能让我静下心来面对生活。没有它的话，我大概早就被压力和情绪压垮了。”
“嗯？难道不是寄托了对什么重要的人的思念？”
“啊？啊——怎、怎么会这样说啊？”初华第一次露出惊慌失措的表情。
“毕竟我看到的初华小姐，不管是静下来看星空时，还是学习占卜时，眼神都像是期盼着能与某位重要的人分享，并为之祈福的样子呢。”
“呃，有这么明显吗？”初华慌张了起来，脸也变得有些红。
“没有什么好害羞的，因为我也是这样的，我完全能理解初华小姐！”
“欸，星极小姐也……？”
“是的，我有个很重要的妹妹也在罗德岛上，为了她不努力可不行。虽然我也会经常被她抱怨是个石头脑袋。哈哈，看来要做个好姐姐还是挺难的。”
原来这个人也一样啊，说不定也是因此，我们才能如此聊得来？
“可能观星是因为喜好，但是初华小姐对占卜也这么好奇，可不就是为了他人吗？”
“星极小姐可真是……”初华想要感谢星极，这样想着的时候，星极突然充满兴趣地靠近了一点。
“那对初华小姐来说，对方是亲人吗？朋友？兄弟？对方是在这里吗？还是身在初华小姐的故乡？”
“呃，啊……这……稍微……有点复杂……”
